issuing_body: Office of Science and Technology Policy (OSTP), The White House
implementation_notes: This is a non-binding technical companion to the Blueprint for an AI Bill of Rights. It provides illustrative examples and practical steps but explicitly states expectations are a 'blueprint for the development of additional technical standards' rather than enforceable rules. Reporting expectations are directed at entities developing or using automated systems but are voluntary. The document covers five principles intended to guide design, use, and deployment of automated systems.
